function.name: AMD_PM_LOG::set_curve_opt_percore
function.signature: undefined set_curve_opt_percore(int param_1, int param_2, int param_3)

cautions: Ghidra rebases original ELF addresses by 0x100000; file-offset resolution and exact symbol identity were checked.
Mixed calling conventions make several pseudo-code PCI arguments incorrect. Original instruction operands remain authoritative.
A8 is a firmware query, not a portable constant. It is not added to the runtime allowlist.
The int constructor uses a different layout/count path from the default constructor and get_pm_patch. Do not mix their offsets.
Public setter command 06 and low-16-bit count encoding supplement original setter evidence. Original D5-plus-06 sequences and port scans are not reproduced.
Curve readback compares exact canonical signed-32-bit counts; physical voltage, core mapping and machine stability remain untested.

offset_query_call_gate.observation: A zero flag branches past the A8 wrapper call at 0x7646d8. A nonzero flag calls it and formats the returned word for a Qt field.
offset_query_call_gate.limitation: This identifies the original platform path, not a validated MP1 initialization/response protocol or PM-table schema.
